stormont.title: Northern Ireland House of Commons elections, constituency results
stormont.note: The page covers 1921 to 1972, but its per-election result tables were not opened in this pass; sources.md says ark.ac.uk serves a UserCheck page to scripts, so fetch it in a browser.

ni_assembly.title: Northern Ireland Elections Excel archive: Assembly, Convention, and Forum counts
ni_assembly.publisher: ARK, Queen's University Belfast, with the McDougall Trust
ni_assembly.format: XLSX per election, every STV count
ni_assembly.note: Separate workbooks cover 1973, 1975 (Convention), 1982, and 1996 (Forum and talks); the 1973 HTML results are at ark.ac.uk/elections/fa73.htm.

commons.title: UK House of Commons Election Results at Candidate Level (Umit dataset)
commons.note: Already the gb.umit source for 1832 to 2024 except 1868; the 1880 Dungannon contest is lost to a date issue in the pipeline, so this is a fix.

ep.title: EP Election Results at Constituency Level, 1979 to 2019
ep.publisher: European University Institute, European Governance and Politics Programme
ep.note: Covers every member state, so it also serves as a cross-check for the 1989 and 1994 UK contests.

councils.title: Local Elections Archive Project, England and Wales council wards
councils.note: Already compiled as gb.leap for 2002 to 2017, so the 2003 and 2011 gaps are coverage gaps, not a new source.

councils.title: Democracy Club local results CSV archive
councils.note: Already the gb.dc_local source; 2019 is the gap year it covers.

councils.title: Scottish council STV count reports (Candidate Votes per Stage)
councils.format: text-layer PDF per ward, read with pdftotext
councils.note: The council sites hold the 2007, 2012, and 2017 reports; the prorep mirror was checked only for 2022, so confirm it holds the earlier years.

national_council.title: Bundesblatt lists of elected National Council members by constituency and round
national_council.publisher: Die Bundesversammlung, published in the Bundesblatt; held by the Federal Archives
national_council.format: scanned PDF with an automatic text view
national_council.note: The lists name the winners and the round, not vote totals; the 1911 list (BBl 1911 V 87, fedlex.admin.ch/eli/fga/1911/5_87__/de) is confirmed, and the other years were not opened.

national_council.title: Bundesblatt lists of elected National Council members by constituency and round
national_council.publisher: Die Bundesversammlung, published in the Bundesblatt; held by the Federal Archives
national_council.format: scanned PDF with an automatic text view
national_council.note: Same series as the 1848 to 1917 lead; the years were not opened, so confirm each Gesamterneuerung list exists.

national_council.title: Politischer Atlas der Schweiz: Nationalratswahlen
national_council.note: Gives party vote shares, not constituency winners, so use it as a cross-check.

council_of_states.title: Bundesblatt lists of elected Council of States members (Verzeichnis der Mitglieder des schweizerischen Standerates)
council_of_states.publisher: Die Bundesversammlung, published in the Bundesblatt; held by the Federal Archives
council_of_states.format: scanned PDF with an automatic text view
council_of_states.note: The 1911 list is BBl 1911 V 104, seen in the Fedlex index; the other years were not opened.

council_of_states.title: Ratsmitglieder seit 1848 (Council members since 1848, historic list)
council_of_states.format: machine-readable export (XLSX from the web service)
council_of_states.grain: canton and election date per member
council_of_states.note: Gives each member's canton and dates, which is enough to name the winner of each cantonal seat on its election date; the export was not downloaded.

federal_votes.title: Federal vote results and commune status, real-time and final
federal_votes.note: The dataset identifiers are listed in sources.md, but were not checked for these two years.

dail.title: ElectionsIreland.org: Dáil general election results by constituency
dail.note: Each 1922 constituency has a page with candidates, first preferences, quota, and counts (Galway and Cavan checked); unopposed constituencies list the members returned. Check the site's reuse terms, and tie totals to the party summary before loading.

dail.title: ElectionsIreland.org: Dáil general election results by constituency
dail.note: The same site covers every Dáil election; no official count volumes before 1954 were found online.

dail.title: Election results and transfer of votes in general election (Stationery Office volumes)
dail.publisher: Dail Eireann, Stationery Office; Oireachtas Library
dail.format: PDF volumes with a text layer (seen for 1957, 1961, 1965, and 1969)
dail.note: One volume per general election, with the by-elections of the outgoing Dáil; file names follow 26thDail_June1989.pdf and 20thDail_February1973_ByeElections19th_1969_1973.pdf. Volumes for 1973, 1981, 1982, 1987, 1989, 1992, and 1997 were seen; earlier ones down to 1954 are in the National Library's holdings list.

president.title: Toghcháin Uachtaráin 1938 to 2025: Presidential Elections, results per constituency
president.publisher: Presidential Returning Officer (Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage)
president.note: One booklet covers every presidential election since 1938, linked from the page.

president.title: Presidential election count CSVs (1945, 1990, 1997, and 2011 seen)
president.publisher: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage (DHLGH Open Data)
president.note: Only the years listed on data.gov.ie were seen; the 1973 and 1976 contests were not checked.

referendums.title: Referendum Results 1937 to 2024 (booklet, per constituency)
referendums.publisher: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage
referendums.format: PDF booklet with a text layer
referendums.note: The same booklet is linked from referendum.ie, which lists every referendum since 1937.

local.title: Local Elections 2019: Results, Transfer of Votes and Statistics
local.publisher: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage
local.format: PDF results book with a text layer (DHLGH Open Data copy, 21 MB)
local.note: Count sheets for each local electoral area; the book is the official count.

local.title: Local election results 2014 and 2024 (DHLGH local elections page)
local.publisher: Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage
local.note: The same publisher issues the 2019 book; the 2014 and 2024 files were not opened, so confirm them before use.

provincial.title: Elections Ontario historical results: Data Explorer and statistical reports
provincial.format: web data explorer; CSV reports per election through an API
provincial.note: Covers Ontario only; no free source was confirmed for the other provinces, so most provincial gaps stay open.

commons_by.title: History of the Federal Electoral Ridings, general and by-elections
commons_by.note: Already in ca.lop with by-elections (type B/P) back to 1867, so this gap is loader coverage.

commons_by.title: Elections Canada by-election reports (ovr_{year} folders)
commons_by.format: HTML home page and CSV per riding (pollresults_resultatsbureau{FED}.csv)
commons_by.note: The pattern is verified for 2016 and later; the 2005 to 2014 folders were not opened.

commons.title: History of the Federal Electoral Ridings, 1949 general election
commons.note: Already in ca.lop, so this gap is loader coverage.

municipales.title: Elections municipales 1989, resultats du 2e tour pour les communes de plus de 9000 habitants
municipales.publisher: Sciences Po CIDSP (Ministry of the Interior source)
municipales.note: Round 2 only, and only for communes over 9,000 people; the smaller communes need another source.

municipales.title: Resultats des elections municipales 2001 (Interior Ministry)
municipales.format: XLS for France as a whole, ZIP per commune over 9,000 (rounds 1 and 2)
municipales.note: Data.sciencespo also holds the 2001 rounds for communes of 3,500 and over, under its own DOIs.

municipales.title: Elections municipales 2008: Resultats (communes over 3,500 and under 3,500)
municipales.format: XLS (two datasets, one for each size class)
municipales.note: A polling-station dataset for communes over 3,500 is also on data.gouv.fr for 2008.

municipales.title: Resultats des elections municipales et communautaires 2014 and 2020
municipales.note: The archive lists both elections; file formats were not opened.

municipales.title: Elections municipales 2026 - Résultats du premier tour (files for French Polynesia), and the second-round dataset
municipales.format: CSV: the ministry publishes French Polynesia in its own three files (elected, results by commune, results by polling station), apart from the France-wide files fr.municipales loaded; results also at https://www.resultats-elections.interieur.gouv.fr/municipalesPolynesieFrancaise2026/
municipales.note: French Polynesia's 48 communes are the gap to fill. The other 68 missing are the communes with no candidates, whose cancelled elections are rerun later.

departementales.title: Resultats des elections departementales 2015 and 2021
departementales.note: Both elections are listed on the Interior results page.

departementales.title: Resultats des elections cantonales (archive)
departementales.note: The archive lists cantonales 2011 and earlier years; the exact years were not confirmed.

regionales.title: Resultats des elections regionales (Interior archive)
regionales.note: Only the archive index was seen; the regional years and file formats need confirming.

assemblee.title: Legislative election results by constituency, 1958 to 2012 (except 1986)
assemblee.format: CSV zip, one file per round
assemblee.note: Already loaded as fr.cdsp, so the gap is loader coverage.

president.title: Donnees des elections agregees (data.gouv.fr)
president.note: The sources.md entry marks 2017 and 2022 as verified, so this gap is loader coverage.

ep.title: European Parliament election results, 2024
ep.note: Official, but the portal is national in grain, so check whether French constituency results exist.

camara.title: Dados estatísticos: eleições federal, estadual e municipal (TSE volumes from 1945)
camara.publisher: Tribunal Superior Eleitoral; Departamento de Imprensa Nacional (digitized by the Câmara dos Deputados library)
camara.note: Volume 1 covers 1945 to 1949, volume 2 covers 1950, volume 4 covers 1958, volume 9 covers 1970, and volume 11 covers 1974. Open each volume for its Chamber tables; IBGE's yearbooks hold the seat counts used for the denominator.

camara.title: Anuário Estatístico do Brasil 1983: Votos apurados, por partido político, segundo as Unidades da Federação, 1982
camara.note: The yearbook prints party votes and the winners' counts by state (p. 354), not candidate votes; the TSE's 1982 volume is the fuller source if it turns up.

senado.title: Dados estatísticos: eleições federal, estadual e municipal (TSE volumes from 1945)
senado.publisher: Tribunal Superior Eleitoral; Departamento de Imprensa Nacional (digitized by the Câmara dos Deputados library)
senado.note: The same volumes carry the Senate tables for each federal election; open each volume for its Senate section.

senado.title: Anuário Estatístico do Brasil 1983: Votos apurados, por partido político, segundo as Unidades da Federação, 1982
senado.note: The yearbook prints party votes and the winners' counts by state (p. 354), not candidate votes; the TSE's 1982 volume is the fuller source if it turns up.

senado.title: Votacao por secao 2022 (all offices but president)
senado.format: CSV zip (Latin-1, semicolon-separated); per state as votacao_secao_2022_{UF}.zip
senado.note: Verified in sources.md; the per-state zips carry the senate, governor, and assembly races.

governor.title: Dados estatísticos: eleições federal, estadual e municipal (TSE volumes from 1945)
governor.publisher: Tribunal Superior Eleitoral; Departamento de Imprensa Nacional (digitized by the Câmara dos Deputados library)
governor.note: The volumes cover the state elections from 1947; governors' terms were staggered, so each volume holds the states that voted that year.

governor.title: Anuário Estatístico do Brasil 1983: Votos apurados, por partido político, segundo as Unidades da Federação, 1982
governor.note: The yearbook prints party votes and the winners' counts by state (p. 354), not candidate votes; the TSE's 1982 volume is the fuller source if it turns up.

assemblies.title: Dados estatísticos: eleições federal, estadual e municipal (TSE volumes from 1945)
assemblies.publisher: Tribunal Superior Eleitoral; Departamento de Imprensa Nacional (digitized by the Câmara dos Deputados library)
assemblies.note: The volumes cover the state assembly elections from 1947; open each volume for its Assembly tables.

assemblies.title: Anuário Estatístico do Brasil 1983: Votos apurados, por partido político, segundo as Unidades da Federação, 1982
assemblies.note: The yearbook prints party votes and the winners' counts by state (p. 354), not candidate votes; the TSE's 1982 volume is the fuller source if it turns up.

president.title: Dados estatísticos: eleições federal, estadual e municipal (TSE volumes from 1945)
president.publisher: Tribunal Superior Eleitoral; Departamento de Imprensa Nacional (digitized by the Câmara dos Deputados library)
president.note: Presidential tables are expected in volumes 1, 2, 3, and 5, which have not been opened yet.

municipal.title: Votacao candidato, partido, and detalhe por municipio e zona (votacao_candidato_munzona_{year}.zip)
municipal.format: CSV zip (Latin-1), one _BRASIL.csv member per year
municipal.note: Verified for 1994 to 2018 in sources.md (br.tse_history), so the gap is loader coverage for the municipal years.

municipal.title: Municipal election results 2020 and 2024 (TSE open data)
municipal.note: The TSE portal should hold these years; the file layout was not checked.

local.title: YSK local election archive (text-layer PDFs, and XLSX for 2014)
local.note: Already the tr.ysk_local source for 1963 to 2014; the missing years need their archive pages checked, since the files may be scans.

tbmm_by.title: YSK by-election decisions in the Resmi Gazete
tbmm_by.publisher: Yuksek Secim Kurulu and Resmi Gazete
tbmm_by.note: The tr.gazette pipeline already reads Resmi Gazete scans, and the by-election decisions sit in the issues for each year; the issues were not located.

senate.title: YSK Senate results notice in Resmi Gazete 11735 (decision 1471)
senate.publisher: Yuksek Secim Kurulu and Resmi Gazete
senate.format: scanned PDF (fetch with a browser-like user agent)
senate.note: Already noted in sources.md as tr.gazette's Senate source for 1961 to 1979, so this is a loader gap.

tbmm.title: Milletvekili Genel Seçimleri, 1923-2011 (TÜİK publication 3685), Tablo 6: seats by party for each province, 1946
tbmm.publisher: Türkiye İstatistik Kurumu (TÜİK), hosted by YSK
tbmm.note: TÜİK says no votes by province survive for 1946, so these contests can only be held as winners by party (bare). Members' names by province are in the TBMM's 8th-term member list.

senato.title: Eligendo Archivio: Senate results since 1948 (Elezioni politiche open data)
senato.format: zip per election (file names not checked)
senato.note: The open data page lists Politiche from 1948, and the Senate result pages for 1948 and 1992 were seen; the existing it.storico loader covers the Chamber, so the Senate is an extension of it.

camera.title: Chamber of Deputies historical archive (camera-{YYYYMMDD}.zip)
camera.format: zip with latin1 CSV (1948 to 1992 as TXT)
camera.note: Verified in sources.md as it.storico for 1948 to 2018, so these gaps are loader coverage.

regionali.title: Eligendo Archivio: general cycles of regional elections since 1970
regionali.note: The open data page lists Cicli generali di elezioni regionali dal 1970.

ep.title: Eligendo Archivio: European elections since 1979
ep.note: The open data page lists Elezioni europee dal 1979.

referendums.title: Eligendo Archivio: referendums since 1946
referendums.note: The open data page lists Referendum dal 1946; the 1946 institutional vote is one contest.

landtage.title: Ergebnisse fruherer Landtagswahlen (Land-level results since 1946)
landtage.format: text-layer PDF, one file for all years
landtage.note: Gives voters, votes, and seats by party for every Land since 1946, per the table of contents.

landtage.title: GERDA state election data (municipality, unharmonized; constituency 1990 to 2026)
landtage.note: Municipal results sum to Land level; the license was not checked.

landtage.title: Land statistical offices: Landtag results by Wahlkreis
landtage.publisher: Statistische Landesamter (for example Sachsen-Anhalt and Thuringen)
landtage.note: One set per Land; Sachsen-Anhalt offers CSV from 1990, and Thuringen offers Excel from 1994.

ep.title: EP Election Results at Constituency Level, 1979 to 2019
ep.publisher: European University Institute, European Governance and Politics Programme
ep.note: Covers the 1989, 1994, 1995, and 2007 contests if the file holds every member state, which its title says.

ep.title: EU-NED, EU election results at NUTS level (Schraff et al.)
ep.note: NUTS-level, so it does not give constituency winners; coverage years were not checked.

ep.title: European Parliament results portal, 2024 election
ep.note: The sources.md BLUE_EP compilation (municipal, 2019 and 2024) is the other candidate, but its URL is not recorded there.
